snippet.title: Khimera: Destroy All Monster Girls - Trailer
snippet.description:
UPDATE: Khimera hits Steam May 9th http://store.steampowered.com/app/467380/

The trailer for 'Khimera: Destroy All Monster Girls', the latest and greatest from Suits & Sandals. Keep up to date by checking http://www.suitgames.com or follow @SyaxAttack on twitter.

Special thanks to Joe 'doc' Aquiare for the music:
https://soundcloud.com/joeaquiare

I expect mastergodzilla to make a hardcore version in about a week.
